note: Wool Blankets & Sleeping Bags: bedding for a shelter's household, replacing the engine's hidden bedding constant (HEAT_BEDDING_HDD). Its effect (the host shelter's heat need x a multiplier) is an engine modifier in catalog_overrides.json, like the weatherization retrofit. Rows only.

systems.name: Wool Blankets & Sleeping Bags
systems.description: Wool blankets and cold-rated sleeping bags for everyone who sleeps in the shelter.
systems.notes: Lowers the host shelter's heat need: people stay warm at a lower indoor temperature (engine modifier, catalog_overrides.json).

flows.note: Weekly upkeep hours (Systems column K): airing and washing.
